title: Phone executor: Positions/Closed read waits for the tab chips on the /trade terminal; a miss dumps where it is
note: [2026-10-13 lane, dispatched by manager session_01G16FfyYSmDPQuuW55BuTmK] positions_state=no_tab on every breakout_2 account_status since the #17793 deploy. ROOT CAUSE (from code; the live page was not inspected): (1) the no_tab path returned a bare {state:no_tab} so the miss dump's headers:[] controls:[] were an ARTEFACT of the miss object carrying no dump, not evidence the document was empty; (2) readView clicked once with no wait, but the bottom-panel chips render after readyState complete and readAccount ran right after settle()/load (background engine path bgJob: load home() -> settle(document complete) -> readAccount) gated only on terminal().ready, which other signals (order control, probe) can satisfy before the chips exist; (3) clickText only matches button/[role=tab]/[role=button]/a, so a plain div/span chip with a count badge is invisible to it. FIX: readView waits up to 12 s for __ex.tabChips(), opens terminalHref when on an account page that is not /trade (not while the operator is using the screen), clicks via clickTab (adds leaf div/span/li chips), and a genuine miss now posts state 'no_tab d<path_depth> c<chips> t<trade>' plus a masked leaf-text list and controls; server scrubs the miss state. Read-only; no order path; reconcile stays report_only, >15-row refusal untouched. landed_unproven until the APK ships and a live read returns positions_state=read.

observation.what: breakout_2 positions_state == read and ticket prop-manual-762f959676fd moves to filled/open
